title: Open frontiers in calibrated and robust learned inversion

items.title: Coverage error under score, forward-solver, and finite-time error
items.statement: For a fixed finite-dimensional Gaussian sequence inverse experiment, determine a uniform bound on frequentist coverage error for credible balls computed from a learned-score reverse sampler, an approximate forward operator, finite Euler steps, and finitely many draws.

items.title: Minimax recovery under bounded operator and truth-law shift
items.statement: For a compact Sobolev ellipsoid in a Gaussian sequence inverse problem, determine the minimax test risk for a learner trained under one truth law and diagonal forward map when both the truth law and the relative operator are shifted by declared Wasserstein and operator-norm radii.

items.title: Finite-compute mode fidelity for score-based posterior samplers
items.statement: For separated finite Gaussian-mixture posterior targets, determine sharp nonasymptotic Wasserstein and mode-region error bounds for a reverse-SDE sampler with bounded score error, finitely many Euler steps, and finitely many trajectories.

items.title: Joint sample and mesh rates for neural inverse maps
items.statement: For a compact infinite-dimensional diagonal inverse-map domain, determine the minimax continuum prediction risk of bounded-parameter Fourier neural operators trained on finitely many noisy mesh samples, jointly as sample size and mesh resolution vary.

title: Open frontiers in calibrated and robust learned inversion — Examples and Counterexamples

items.title: Exact Gaussian credible-ball coverage with a score-error budget of zero
items.statement: Compute the repeated-sampling coverage of the exact Gaussian posterior credible interval in a scalar normal-mean experiment.

items.title: A proper Gaussian prior gives nonuniform finite-sample coverage on an unbounded truth class
items.statement: Show that the central posterior credible interval in the scalar normal-mean model has coverage tending to zero as the true mean tends to infinity at fixed sample size.

items.title: A scalar inverse with a conditioning-dependent shift modulus
items.statement: Compute the exact squared-error risk of the working inverse under a bounded scalar operator shift and bound the risk change under a Wasserstein shift of the truth law.

items.title: Small absolute operator error does not give a uniform inverse bound without conditioning
items.statement: Construct scalar operators at arbitrarily small absolute distance for which the fixed working inverse has a nonvanishing reconstruction error.

items.title: Exact iid samples estimate two-mode posterior weights
items.statement: Compute the empirical Wasserstein error and probability of omitting a mode for iid samples from a two-atom posterior.

items.title: No fixed sample budget uniformly protects arbitrarily rare modes
items.statement: Show that the probability of missing the rare atom in a two-mode posterior approaches one when its mass approaches zero at any fixed finite trajectory count.

items.title: A diagonal inverse has an explicit Fourier truncation error
items.statement: Bound the continuum reconstruction error of a truncated inverse on a compact Sobolev ellipsoid under mesh truncation and bounded measurement error.

items.title: Finite samples cannot identify every Lipschitz inverse map uniformly
items.statement: For any finite set of scalar inputs, construct two one-Lipschitz target maps that agree on the samples but differ away from them by a quantified amount.
